messages:
sara (Design): Quick design review — rollout timeline mock v3 attached. Focus: canary slider UX, rollback flow, and compact version-history scroller. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/XXXX/rollout-v3

kevin (Product): Love the scroller. Two quick Qs: 1) Should we keep the word 'Canary' for non-technical users? Maybe label it 'Partial rollout' with a tooltip. 2) Rollback CTA — destructive or reversible?

dmitri (Eng): Implementation heads-up: slider needs fine-grained values (0.5%) for canaries. Also needs keyboard + screen-reader stepper. Beware floating-point rounding when we persist percentages in the backend.

alex (Accessibility): A11y nits: canary badge color contrast currently ~2.8:1 — needs >=4.5:1. Focus ring missing on slider handle. Animated timeline expand should respect prefers-reduced-motion. Also ensure the slider handle has an accessible name.

sara (Design): Good catches. Proposed microcopy options (quick paste):
```
- Label: "Partial rollout"
- Tooltip: "Gradually roll out a version to a subset of traffic. Use this to validate changes before full release."
- Rollback CTA copy: "Rollback to previous version — reversible within 5 minutes."
```
Thoughts?

kevin (Product): Prefer 'Partial rollout' as the primary label + a tiny 'Canary' teardrop for power users. For rollback text I want precise language: "Rollback — reverts traffic to the last stable version and queues a redeploy. Undo available for 10 minutes." That sets expectations.

dmitri (Eng): We can support an "undo for 10 minutes" window by keeping rollback metadata for that retention period. Cost: ~150MB extra per deploy in metadata storage, and small additional retention logic. OK technically but need product approval.

alex (Accessibility): Also add an aria-live region for rollout status updates (e.g., "Starting rollout", "Stable", "Rollback complete"). Spinner needs `aria-label="Rolling out…"`. Slider handles should expose their value via `aria-valuenow` and a descriptive `aria-label` like "canary percentage".

sara (Design): I'll switch label to 'Partial rollout' with a `?` tooltip that expands on hover/focus and includes the phrase "also known as canary" for discoverability. I'll update the figma and add an a11y checklist.

kevin (Product): Can we show a last-deploy timestamp and offer an expand-to-see details (commit message + changelog link) from the timeline item? PMs want quick context.

dmitri (Eng): Timeline item will include short commit hash + changelog link. For very long histories we'll lazy-load older entries and limit the initial payload. Also recommend server-side pagination of versions.

deploy-bot: Preview build created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/rollout-v3 (env: staging).

sara (Design): Pushing a final artboard by EOD. Added the microcopy into figma comments and flagged the contrast change. Tagging @alex to recheck after update. :eyes: :thumbsup:

alex (Accessibility): Will re-review after the update. Quick note for engineers: labelling the slider handle id/class as "canary-percentage" and exposing it via accessibility tree will simplify e2e a11y tests.

kevin (Product): If everyone is aligned I'll schedule a quick PM/design sync tomorrow to lock copy and the rollback retention tradeoff. Thanks all! :rocket:
